content: Veralogix could form a consortium with other specialized service providers—for example, a geological consulting firm and a load-and-haul contractor—to jointly bid for larger projects, allowing them to offer a more integrated solution without the need for a formal merger. Finally, Veralogix must keep a close watch on M&A activity in the sector.
